design: blind review of the three new Sonnet shards: 40 va02 sessions and 40 tr05/tr06 sessions, labelled by independent annotator agents without labels; disagreements adjudicated by one reader
rule: F1 >= 0.80 and <= 10% sessions with an error: met for both; shards accepted
notes: minor omissions of person-role facts found in a few sessions (teacher left out; annotator added), not counted as errors
